title.zh: 浦东教发院：六、七年级数学新教材培训
国家英语课标2022（背景资料）

kind.en: Background only; not substituted for Shanghai books
kind.zh: 只作背景；不代替上海教材

shanghai.en: Compare amounts and count objects in everyday play.
shanghai.zh: 在生活与游戏中比较多少、点数实物。

difference.en: The concepts overlap. Marble splits them into skills; the early-years guide uses play and developmental expectations, not school lessons.
difference.zh: 概念有交集。Marble 拆成技能节点，学前指南以游戏与发展表现组织，不是小学课程。

shanghai.en: Explore adding and removing with objects at the older preschool stage.
shanghai.zh: 大班阶段通过实物操作体验合并、拿走与数量变化。

difference.en: Concrete experience is the connection; this does not prescribe written arithmetic drills or an age deadline.
difference.zh: 对应的是实物经验，不等于提前练笔算，也不把参考年龄当达标期限。

shanghai.en: Explore shapes, position and spatial relationships.
shanghai.zh: 感知形状、位置和空间关系。

difference.en: Marble names individual shape skills. The preschool reference centres on exploration with real objects.
difference.zh: Marble 列出具体图形技能；学前依据强调在实物探索中感知。

shanghai.en: The 2024 Grade 1 first-volume index lists solid and plane shapes.
shanghai.zh: 2024版一年级上册目录列出立体图形与平面图形。

difference.en: Shared concepts; a chapter title cannot establish every shape taught or the required depth. Original-book verification is pending.
difference.zh: 概念对应；仅凭目录不能确定具体图形范围和要求深度，仍待原书复核。

shanghai.en: The index includes numbers to 10 and then to 20.
shanghai.zh: 目录包含10以内的数、20以内的数。

difference.en: Marble separates writing numerals, teen-number structure and tens. These are candidate links, not an official equivalence.
difference.zh: Marble 分列数字书写、十几的组成与十进位概念。这是候选关联，不是官方等同。

shanghai.en: Parts-and-wholes activities appear in the numbers-to-10 unit.
shanghai.zh: 10以内的数单元中安排分与合。

difference.en: Several Marble nodes describe related number decompositions. The source title “Number bonds to 9” has a description about making ten; the Chinese guide follows that description.
difference.zh: 多个 Marble 节点对应数的分解。其中一个英文标题写“到9”，正文实际描述凑十；中文导读依据正文。

shanghai.en: The index progresses from arithmetic within 10 to addition within 20.
shanghai.zh: 目录由10以内加减法推进到20以内加法。

difference.en: Marble distinguishes representations, symbols and strategies. A node covering subtraction within 20 is broader than this first-volume entry.
difference.zh: Marble 将表征、符号和策略分开；包含20以内减法的节点，范围比此上册目录条目更宽。

shanghai.en: A third-party new-book plan lists two-step arithmetic and word problems.
shanghai.zh: 第三方新教材教案目录列出两步四则运算与应用题。

difference.en: The selected addition/subtraction node covers only part of four-operation problems. Do not infer full coverage from a matching label.
difference.zh: 所选加减两步题节点只覆盖四则问题的一部分，名称相近不等于完全覆盖。

shanghai.en: The plan lists one-digit multiplication of two- and three-digit numbers, with estimation.
shanghai.zh: 教案目录列出一位数乘两、三位数及估算。

difference.en: The written-multiplication node describes the same number sizes. This is a promising match pending textbook verification.
difference.zh: 笔算乘法节点的数位范围相符；这是待课本核实的候选对应。

shanghai.en: The plan introduces angles, triangles and quadrilaterals.
shanghai.zh: 教案目录包含角、三角形和四边形的初步认识。

difference.en: Marble has a broad shape-recognition node and a separate angle-concept node; later geometry should not be assumed part of this unit.
difference.zh: Marble 有一般图形识别与独立的角概念节点；不能把后续几何要求一并算进本单元。

shanghai.en: The visible plan includes one-digit divisors and two-digit dividends.
shanghai.zh: 可见教案目录包含一位数除两位数。

difference.en: This Marble node reaches four-digit dividends and remainders, so its scope is wider. The full Shanghai unit remains unverified.
difference.zh: 这个 Marble 节点还涉及四位数与余数，范围更宽；上海完整单元尚未核实。

shanghai.en: Pudong new-book training stresses asking questions, reasoning and real-world problem solving.
shanghai.zh: 浦东新教材教研强调提问、思考过程和真实问题解决。

difference.en: Both value reasoning. Marble makes it individually browsable; the local source is teaching guidance, not a claim that a particular class always practises it.
difference.zh: 两者都重视推理。Marble 把它拆成可浏览技能；本地来源是教学导向，不能据此判断每个课堂的落实情况。

shanghai.en: Shanghai Grade 1 first-volume Unit 6 My family is documented in local new-book teaching reports.
shanghai.zh: 本地新教材教研明确记录一年级上册第6单元 My family。

difference.en: The Shanghai unit organises language around a theme; Marble groups describing and vocabulary use as reusable skills. Its “with detail” demand may be deeper than the entry task.
difference.zh: 上海单元按家庭主题组织；Marble 将描述、使用词汇列为通用能力。节点中的详细表达要求可能高于入门任务。

shanghai.en: The same teaching report describes listening, speaking, reading and performing activities.
shanghai.zh: 同一教研记录描述听、说、读、演活动。

difference.en: There is overlap in interaction. A local unit does not by itself verify every discussion rule or independent question-asking requirement in Marble.
difference.zh: 互动能力有交集，但一个单元不能证明 Marble 的讨论规则、自主提问要求均已覆盖。

shanghai.en: Shanghai guidance includes subject and cross-subject projects.
shanghai.zh: 上海指导意见包含学科项目与跨学科项目。

difference.en: Marble lists research-related writing skills. This is a method-level connection; the policy does not establish English proficiency or a textbook-specific writing requirement.
difference.zh: Marble 列有研究相关写作技能。这是方法层面的关联，不代表政策规定了英语水平或某册写作要求。

scope.en: Ages 0–12 · Shanghai new-textbook pathway · evidence-building draft
scope.zh: 0–12岁 · 上海新教材路径 · 资料核对中

limits.en: This is not a complete textbook crosswalk yet. Official catalogues confirm book selection, not chapter content. Grey stages are unverified; third-party leads are labelled. National standards are background only.
limits.zh: 尚未完成全套教材逐项对照。官方用书目录只能确认选书依据，不能证明章节内容；灰色学段待核对，第三方线索单独标注。国家课标仅作背景。
